## Workload

During the review period, Hannah Lowe recorded 312 reads over 279 hours. This represents a rate of 1.1 reads per hour. The workload was completed within the hours recorded for the review, with the volume and pace noted for consideration alongside the quality findings.

## Quality

A sample of 39 reads was checked as part of the review. Agreement was 53.8 per cent. The result indicates that the reviewed work requires attention to consistency, particularly where cases are less clear-cut. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support a consistent approach in future grading.

The review was completed by Priya Anand, who considered both the recorded workload and the findings from the checked sample.
